verdict.rationale: First-party docs repeatedly cite 9,000+ apps and 40,000+ actions with managed OAuth and credentials. App vendors build and publish their own integrations to the App Directory, which makes them vendor-maintained. Community users corroborate the breadth of the catalog, the steady arrival of new integrations, and the value of not building custom API integrations. Missing for 10: independent evidence on the upkeep quality and reliability of the vendor-maintained connectors; the community catalog-size reference (~1,000) is dated.
